title: BA1/2445/2023 of PRAVEEN Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
First Bail Application No.2445 of 2023
Praveen ........Applicant

Present:-
Mr. Parikshit Saini, Advocate for the applicant.
 Mr. M.A. Khan, AGA for the State.

Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
 Applicant is in judicial custody in FIR/Case
Crime No.277 of 2023, under Sections 323, 452, 504, 506
and 326 IPC, Police Station Pathri, District Haridwar. He
has sought his release on bail.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and
perused the record.
3. According to the FIR, on 26.06.2023 at about
8:30 PM, the co-accused were making a lot of noise in
front of the house of the nephew of the informant. When
they were stopped to do so, they extended threats. On the
same day, when the informant was returning to his house,
the applicant as well as the co-accused armed with lathi,
danda & rods entered into the house of the informant,
abused them and co-accused Ajay hit the informant on
his head, due to which, he sustained serious injuries.

2
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit
that the role of attacking is assigned to the co-accused; no
role of assault has been assigned to the applicant,
merely, the role assigned is that the applicant abused the
informant.
5. Learned State Counsel admits these facts.
6. Having considered the entirety of facts, this
Court is of the view that the applicant deserves to be
enlarged on bail.
7. The bail application is allowed.
8. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his
executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable
sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the
Court concerned.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 01.07.2024
Ravi
